map.压差小/小电流/低噪声 → LDO；压差大/大电流/效率敏感 → DCDC。本工: Small voltage drop / small current / low noise → LDO; large voltage drop / large current / efficiency sensitive → DCDC. map.DCDC 有开关纹波（数十 mV），需 LC 滤波；LDO 输出极低噪声但效率低: DCDC has switching ripple (tens of mV) and needs LC filtering; LDO has very low output noise but low efficiency. This tool provides basic electronics calculations; results are for circuit design and teaching reference only, and do not replace formal PCB design, EMC and product reliability requirements.
map.Buck 仅降压；Buck-Boost（SEPIC）支持 Vin 可高可低于 V: Buck only steps down; Buck-Boost (SEPIC) tolerates Vin above or below Vout; the topology is more complex.
